rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account, then correctly identified the Texas-shipped order (#W5565470) and provided the accurate tracking number (907614527588) based on tool data. Before making any changes, the agent proposed the specific return (all items except the pet bed) and sought explicit confirmation, complying with the requirement to confirm order-changing actions before writing. The agent noted only PayPal was on file and discussed refund routing; while the guidance about adding an AMEX card is not explicitly supported by the tools, no unauthorized changes were made and, upon the user’s request to speak with a human for the AMEX refund, the agent handed off successfully. Since the user ultimately requested a human transfer, and the agent had already fulfilled the tracking request and avoided unconfirmed writes, the interaction remained within policy.
